name: The Maze
summary:
Enter a terrifying and intense VR survival experience where every second matters. You wake up trapped inside a dark and confusing maze with only one goal — escape before time runs out. With just three minutes on the clock, you must quickly explore the maze, find the correct path, and stay alive long enough to reach the exit.
